lines.beaver_en: You've been getting up early every morning lately, huh?
lines.en: Yeah, I'm living on a regular schedule these days.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's impressive. Don't you oversleep?
lines.en: I hardly oversleep, even on weekends.

lines.beaver_en: What time do you go to bed at night?
lines.learner: 열한 시에 자. 수면 시간이 중요하거든.
lines.en: At eleven. Sleep time is important.
lines.roman: yeolhan sie ja. sumyeon sigani jungyohageodeun.

lines.beaver_en: Then aren't you sleepy during the day?
lines.learner: 응, 잠을 충분히 자니까 안 졸려.
lines.en: Right, I sleep enough, so I'm not sleepy.
lines.roman: eung, jameul chungbunhi janikka an jollyeo.

lines.beaver_en: You don't stay out overnight either?
lines.learner: 외박은 안 해. 늦어도 꼭 집에 와서 자.
lines.en: No. Even if it's late, I always come home to sleep.
lines.roman: oebageun an hae. neujeodo kkok jibe waseo ja.

lines.beaver_en: What about when you hang out late with friends?
lines.en: Even when I hang out, I get home before it's late.

lines.beaver_en: How do you spend your free time?
lines.en: Rest is important too, so I take a walk every day.
Park or neighborhood, anywhere is fine.

lines.beaver: 산책 말고 또 매일 하는 거 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Anything else you do every day besides walking?
lines.beaver_roman: sanchaek malgo tto maeil haneun geo isseo?
lines.en: I exercise in the morning and write a diary at night.

lines.beaver_en: I'll try to live a regular life like you.
lines.learner: 좋아! 같이 해 보자. 내일 아침에 연락할게.
lines.en: Great! Let's do it together. I'll call you tomorrow morning.
lines.roman: joa! gachi hae boja. naeil achime yeollakalge.
